notes: Curated OE slot remaps where literal H3→OE mapping makes combination sets unwinnable. OE has 4 accessory (item_slot) slots; H3 has 5 Misc. Native OE sets already remap necklace-like pieces onto belt (e.g. Angelic Alliance celestial sash).

overrides.reason: Statue of Legion is five Misc pieces in H3; OE only has four accessory slots. Loins maps thematically to belt so all five components can be worn together without stealing head/armor/boots from real equipment.
